name: load_data
description: Run load procedure SQL files in order, waiting for each to complete and stopping when its status table has rows that are not successful.
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

arguments.name: connection
arguments.description: Oracle connection with IP, PORT (1-65535) and SID.

arguments.name: credentials
arguments.description: Schema credentials: an object (or a JSON string of one) with username and password.

arguments.name: procedures
arguments.description: Procedure SQL files run in order, from the plugin's sqls folder; each a file name or an object with 'sql' and its own 'status_check'.

arguments.name: status_check
arguments.description: Default check after each procedure: table, column (default STATUS) and success_value (default SUCCESS); rows whose column is NULL or differs from success_value stop the run.

arguments.name: sqlhome
arguments.description: Oracle home whose bin/sqlplus is used; sqlplus is taken from PATH when omitted.

outputs.name: completed
outputs.description: Number of procedures that ran and passed their status check.

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Per-procedure results: sql (file), table and not_successful (row count).
